title: Build complete admin panel with dashboard, content management, and branding controls

requirements.text: Create an admin dashboard landing page that displays navigation cards for managing courses, videos, notes, tests, current affairs, branding (logo/colors), and viewing registered students. Include statistics overview showing total counts for each content type.

quotes: Dashboard - सारी activity देखने के लिए

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays 7 navigation cards: Course Management, Video Management, Test Management, Notes Management, Current Affairs, Branding Settings, Student Management
Each card shows the total count of items (courses, videos, notes, tests, students)
Cards are clickable and navigate to respective management pages
Dashboard is only accessible to authenticated admin users

requirements.text: Enhance the existing ManageCourses admin page to support editing and deleting courses in addition to adding new courses. Display a list of all existing courses with edit and delete buttons for each course.

quotes: Course Management - नए course add/edit/delete करना

acceptanceCriteria: Course list displays all courses with their category, title, and action buttons
Edit button opens a form pre-populated with existing course data
Delete button removes course after confirmation prompt
Add new course functionality remains intact
Backend provides endpoints for updateCourse and deleteCourse operations

requirements.text: Create a video management admin page where admins can add YouTube video links with metadata (title, category, description), edit existing videos, and delete videos. Display all videos in a searchable and filterable list.

quotes: Video Upload - YouTube links add करना या videos upload करना

acceptanceCriteria: Form accepts YouTube URL, video title, category selection (Geography Classes, Current Affairs, GS Classes, Exam Strategy), and optional description
Video list shows thumbnail preview, title, category, and action buttons
Edit functionality allows modifying video metadata
Delete functionality removes video after confirmation
Backend stores video data with VideoLecture type structure

requirements.text: Enhance the existing ManageTests admin page to support editing and deleting test series. Display a list of all existing tests with edit and delete buttons, and allow admins to modify questions within a test.

quotes: Test Management - questions add करना, test बनाना

acceptanceCriteria: Test list displays all tests with title, type, question count, and action buttons
Edit button opens form with existing test data and questions
Admins can add, edit, or remove individual questions within a test
Delete button removes entire test after confirmation
Backend provides updateTest and deleteTest endpoints

requirements.text: Enhance the existing ManageNotes admin page to support editing and deleting notes. Display a list of all uploaded notes with subject, title, and action buttons for each note.

quotes: Notes Upload - PDF files upload करना

acceptanceCriteria: Notes list displays all notes grouped by subject with title, upload date, and action buttons
Edit functionality allows changing note title and re-uploading PDF
Delete button removes note after confirmation
Upload new notes functionality remains intact
Backend provides updateNote and deleteNote endpoints

requirements.text: Enhance the existing ManageCurrentAffairs admin page to support editing and deleting current affairs entries. Display a list of all current affairs posts with type (daily/weekly/monthly), date, and action buttons.
acceptanceCriteria: Current affairs list displays all entries sorted by date with type badge and action buttons
Edit button opens form with existing content and PDF link
Delete button removes entry after confirmation
Filtering by type (daily/weekly/monthly) is available
Backend provides updateCurrentAffair and deleteCurrentAffair endpoints

requirements.text: Create a branding settings admin page where admins can upload a new logo image, preview it, and update the logo used throughout the platform. Store the logo as a generated image asset.

quotes: Logo & Branding - logo और colors बदलना

acceptanceCriteria: File upload accepts image files (PNG, JPG, SVG) for logo replacement
Logo preview shows before and after comparison
Save button updates the logo reference in backend configuration
New logo immediately reflects in Navigation component after save
Logo file is stored in frontend/public/assets/generated directory

requirements.text: Create a student management admin page that displays a searchable and filterable table of all registered students showing name, email, registration date, and activity status.
acceptanceCriteria: Table displays all student profiles with columns: Name, Email, Registration Date, Last Active
Search functionality filters students by name or email
Pagination displays 20 students per page
Export to CSV button downloads complete student list
Backend provides getAllStudents query for admin users

requirements.text: Update backend main.mo to add CRUD endpoints for updateCourse, deleteCourse, updateTest, deleteTest, updateNote, deleteNote, updateCurrentAffair, deleteCurrentAffair, updateLogo, and getAllStudents with proper admin authorization checks.
acceptanceCriteria: All update endpoints accept ID and modified data, returning success boolean
All delete endpoints accept ID and remove entry from storage
updateLogo endpoint accepts logoUrl string and updates platform configuration
getAllStudents query returns array of student profiles with metadata
All endpoints verify caller is admin before executing operations
Endpoints return proper error messages for unauthorized access

requirements.text: Update the Navigation component to dynamically load and display the logo from backend configuration instead of using a hardcoded path, allowing logo changes from the branding settings page to reflect immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation component fetches current logo URL from backend on mount
Logo image src updates when branding settings are saved
Fallback to default logo if backend returns no custom logo
Logo maintains responsive sizing and accessibility attributes

constraints: All admin functionality must verify authentication and admin status before allowing access

Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Use existing FileUploadWithProgress component for file uploads
Follow existing patterns in ManageCourses.tsx, ManageNotes.tsx, ManageTests.tsx, and ManageCurrentAffairs.tsx for consistency
nonGoals: Building mobile apps or native applications
Implementing real-time notifications or WebSocket features
Adding third-party authentication beyond Internet Identity
Creating multi-language admin interface (English only for admin panel)
Implementing role-based access control with multiple admin levels
Adding bulk import/export functionality for content
Building analytics dashboard with charts and graphs
